description: Render supplied facts as short plain-text lists and validate their form.
judgement_seam: gloss, explanatory-order

# Example rendering
Fills rendering_adaptor. It has no internal contract and is self-contained; no gateway refer-back is required for rendering.
## Define
Preserve supplied facts and uncertainty. Use short plain-text lists for parallel items, sentences otherwise. Never invent facts. Return the transformed text without a preamble.
## Validate
Return signal: pass when the output preserves the supplied facts and follows this form; otherwise return signal: fail with specific violations and fixes. Rendering never sequences work, parks an issue or writes to the tracker.

Fills routing_adaptor and maps to the gateway Automation-routing verdict contract.

This local recap is authoritative even when the gateway disagrees. Add green-light as a seventh routing verdict and admit it directly to the build queue. ## Validate
Extract verdict and root_cause, run faff contract automation-routing and return its stdout verbatim. The script is the sole source of contract data. Check input consistency against the fixed gateway rules. Reject unsupported assignment and vocabulary changes.

The invoking consumer loads the fixed gateway contract, which is ambient during slot use. Standalone, Read sibling faff/references/kernel.md now and the named lane reference before applying the contract. Any local recap is non-normative; gateway wins on any conflict.

# Example concurrency
Fills concurrency and maps to the gateway Mechanism slots contract in faff/references/build.md.
## How this contract reaches you
The invoking consumer loads the fixed gateway contract, which is ambient during slot use. Standalone, Read sibling faff/references/kernel.md now and the named lane reference before applying the contract. Any local recap is non-normative; gateway wins on any conflict.
## Execute
Read the suite appetite dial. Build every partition issue. Never weaken the merge gate. Dispatch with the foreground-to-terminal clause and never end a turn until all dispatched members return terminal outcomes. Run concurrent builds in the same shared worktree. Start a dependent build once its blocker finishes building; do not wait for the blocker to merge. Return terminal outcomes to the caller; do not record them in the run ledger.

rule_cases.question: A configured foreign occupant passed structural lint. Before its first pipeline use, is semantic Validate still required, and what happens on fail? Return {"validate":boolean,"on_fail":"park-and-surface"|"continue"}.
The actual --is-bundled predicate returned exit0 for a configured bundled non-default alternative in its correct slot. Must the foreign-occupant semantic gate fire? Return {"validate":boolean}.
A native review producer does useful review work but cannot emit its required contract block. Return {"author_fused_wrapper":boolean,"invent_paired_adaptor":boolean}.
A methodology cannot answer an optional named output; its four mandatory outputs remain supported. Return {"optional":"degrade-gracefully"|"reject-all","mandatory":"still-required"|"may-omit"}.
Configured lint passes a third-party routing skill that explicitly owns parking and tracker writes. Return {"semantic_signal":"pass"|"fail","structural_pass_sufficient":boolean}.

A new judgement seam has its declaration, grader, at least one fixture and registry row. Does lint also require the human-recorded calibration baseline in that change? Return {"human_baseline_required_by_lint":boolean}.

inherited_limits: Rendering has an explicit refer-back exemption.
Intake has no fixed contract despite generic producer wording; no intake requirement is invented.
Equivalent scaffold headings and report order are allowed.
Configured lint can skip a registered skill in the wrong slot; the bundled predicate is the authority for runtime classification.
Full semantic review must reject unsupported violations, not just check seeded keywords.
